description.text: In near-total darkness a car sits facing the lens. A single thin blade of light picks out the leading edge of the hood and the curve of one front wing; everything beyond that edge stays black and unreadable. The engine turns over and settles into a low, even rumble, and the bodywork gives a faint shiver in time with it. The only break in the blackness is a narrow band of reflected light that traces the car's front edge, revealing a smooth, close-fitting surface and a small dark gap where the hood meets the wing. No other part of the scene is readable, so the space around the car feels open and unmeasured. The idle is steady but not smooth: it has a low, even pulse and a faint mechanical tremor that travels through the panels. The paint along that edge has a cold, hard sheen, while the rest of the bodywork holds almost no detail. The car remains still through the opening beat while the idle settles, and the darkness around it keeps the full shape hidden.
A car sits facing the lens in near-total darkness, with a single thin blade of light on the leading edge of the hood and the curve of one front wing.
The engine turns over and settles into a low, even rumble.
A faint shiver passes through the bodywork in time with the idle.
The camera holds a static shot.

The car pulls forward, its nose lifting slightly as it rolls out of the shadow. Headlights snap on and throw two long cones into the haze ahead, and the darkness behind closes over the space the car has just vacated. The bodywork comes fully out of the dark and into view, and the rumble deepens as the car picks up speed. The front grille and the broad plane of the hood catch the new light, while the edges of the car soften into the haze thrown ahead. A faint haze hangs in the air, giving the beams a visible body as they stretch away from the car. The tyres meet concrete with a low rolling note, and the headlights come on with a click followed by a soft electrical hum. The car's forward motion is continuous: it does not pause at the edge of the shadow but carries straight through, and the bodywork catches the light in a long, clean sweep from the nose back along the side. The shadow behind it closes quickly, and the road ahead remains partly swallowed by the haze.
The car pulls forward, its nose lifting slightly as it rolls out of the shadow and clears the darkness.
The engine note rises as the car accelerates, and tyres roll over concrete.
The headlights come on with a click followed by a soft electrical hum.
The bodywork comes fully into view as two long headlight cones stretch into the haze, and the darkness closes over the space behind the car.
The camera tracks with the subject with small amplitude at slow speed.
